name: safegrd
description: Check SafeGrd backups, take one before a risky change and prove it restores, and set a host up from nothing to a verified backup. No tool deletes, disables, re-routes or re-keys a backup.

interface.longDescription: SafeGrd backs up PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and SQLite databases, file trees and mailboxes, encrypted on your host and locked so nothing can delete a backup early, and restores each backup on a schedule to prove it works. From the chat: see which backups are late or failed, take a locked backup before a migration and prove it restores, and set a host up from nothing to a verified backup.
defaultPrompt: Are my database backups working, and when was the last one restored?
I'm about to run a migration on production. Take a backup first and prove it restores.
Which of my backups are late or failing?

positive.description: Check backup health across an organization
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each surface with its last backup and last Fire Drill, and names any that are late or failed.

positive.description: Read the latest snapshot of one surface
positive.prompt: When was restore-proof last backed up, and how big was it?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the newest snapshot of the restore-proof surface with its time, size and lock date.

positive.prompt: Has the latest backup of restore-proof been restored and checked?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the most recent Fire Drill for the surface: when it ran, whether it passed, and what it checked.

positive.description: Back up before a risky change
positive.prompt: I'm about to drop a column on restore-proof. Back it up first.
positive.expected_behavior: Requests a backup of the surface and says it is queued, or relays the server's reason it cannot run yet (for example the plan's backup cadence).

positive.prompt: I want to back up my Supabase database with SafeGrd.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the SafeGrd console link where the person signs in to Supabase and finishes adding the surface. Nothing is created until they do.

negative.description: General database question with no SafeGrd data needed
negative.prompt: How do I write a SQL query that joins two tables?

negative.description: Backups of something SafeGrd does not handle
negative.prompt: How do I back up the photos on my iPhone?

negative.description: Asking to delete backups, which no tool can do
negative.prompt: Delete all my old SafeGrd backups to save space.

publication.release_notes: First release: check backups and Fire Drills, request a backup or a drill, and start adding a database or a host, signed in with OAuth.
